conclusion: The144MHz clock mode fails ordinary data processing even without USBScreen, without OTG IRQ and with every IRQ masked in bounded formatter blocks. A CDC change cannot qualify this mode.
limitations: Qualification concerns this Classic and this clock/voltage/Flash configuration; it does not prove allF411 parts cannot operate at144MHz.
Quiet RAM tests demonstrate an error outside CDC, not the exact failing silicon datapath.
Screen matrices collect packet CRC and noncePONG; they do not assemble frames after injected corruptions. Final working check uses the original strict complete-frame collector.
Failed setup attempts and incomplete rows are retained in raw artifacts but excluded from the quiet/qualified matrix.
No speculative FIFO barrier or bytewise CDC replacement is shipped.144MHz remains unqualified.
